notes.text: Note to self: the registration desk always runs out of pens. Bring more. – G. Code: KETTLE 27

config.speaker: Red Panda
lines: Oh, the gnu and his tea. Three sugars, every single cup.
I stopped counting. The sugar bowl was always empty by noon.
config.question: How many sugars did the gnu take in his tea?
config.nudge: Listen to what Red Panda says about the tea.

notes.venue: Seagull hidden in the welcome slides
notes.text: Note to self: the spare key is under the bait bucket. Do not tell the Anglerfish. – G. Code: GULLWING 41

config.speaker: Seagull
lines: Squawk! The gnu hid his spare key under the bait bucket.
He thought no fish would ever look there. He was right.
config.question: Where did the gnu hide his spare key?

notes.text: Note to self: Crab merges every fix, even the tiny ones. Say thank you. – G. Code: DRIPCOFFEE 08

config.speaker: Crab
lines: Snip snip! Every fix that comes in, I merge it.
I never hide one. I never eat one. I merge it.
config.question: What does Crab do with every fix?
config.nudge: Crab is very proud of one thing.

notes.text: Note to self: the Cookie Machine's belt runs towards the Oven. Mind the crumbs. – G. Code: CROSSWIND 63

config.speaker: Penguin
lines: Waddle waddle. The belt on the Cookie Machine runs towards the Oven.
Always has. The rounds go in one end and the Oven gets them.
config.question: Which way does the Cookie Machine's belt run?
config.nudge: Think about where the rounds are going.

notes.text: Note to self: never pack a warm cookie. Gopher will tell you why. – G. Code: INKBLOT 19

config.speaker: Gopher
lines: Paws off the warm ones! I never pack a warm cookie.
Cold cookies travel well. Warm ones crumble in the crate.
config.question: What does Gopher never pack?

notes.text: Note to self: show Elephant everything. The town records are only as good as what goes in. – G. Code: SALTWATER 52

config.speaker: Elephant
lines: I keep the town records. That is what I do.
Not the cookies. Not the keys. The records.
config.question: What does Elephant keep?
config.nudge: Elephant has said it more than once.
